name: xxd-panel-188
title_zh: 暖金建筑档案风，把照片压成 188 号版画
tagline_zh: 手里有张建筑照片却只会套滤镜？它把立面、窗格、阴影压成暖金档案版画，颗粒和留白都按 188 号规格走。
tagline_en: Turn a building photo into a warm-gold archival panel: facades, window grids and shadows flattened into 188-spec.
desc_en: Create Panel 188 raster artwork: Warm Gold Architectural Archive. Use when the user invokes xxd-panel-188 or requests this specific visual language.
why_zh: 不是加滤镜，是先拆立面层级再重排明暗，暖金只落在结构线上，颗粒和留白都锁死在 188 号规格里。
why_en: Not a filter: it decomposes facade layers, re-orders light and shadow, and lets warm gold land only on structural lines, with.
limit_zh: 只做建筑立面这一格，人像、风景、室内会被压成看不懂的色块；输入最好是有清晰窗格或结构线的照片，模糊或夜景基本出不来。
limit_en: Only building facades: portraits, landscapes and interiors flatten into unreadable blocks. Best with clear window grids or structural lines; blurry.
title_en: Warm Gold Architectural Archive: Panel 188 Raster Art
